reply_text:
I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the signed paperwork puts the 2026 Quarrendon renewal at **185 seats**, not the 261 Ilse posted on the 14th. Two days ago I acknowledged Ilse's 261 without checking it. That was my mistake, and the new reply corrects it in the channel.

What the records show:
- **Amendment No. 1:** set the account to 185 seats from 2025-09-01.
- **2026 renewal order form:** signed 2026-03-20 and effective 2026-04-01. It doesn't change the seat count, so 185 carries over.
- **Account record:** shows 185 active seats.
- **Amendment No. 3:** signed 2026-09-22, raises it to 230 seats, but only from 2027-01-01.

Nothing I found mentions 261. In the reply I tagged Ilse to ask where that number came from, in case she has paperwork I can't see.

The reply mentions only seat counts and dates, which anyone on the account's team may see, and no prices or discounts. Dana is in #north-team, and the account and contract records I used belong to the North team, so they're within what she can see.
